description: Bluetooth Low Energy: the SDK's kdrv_ble.c (a NimBLE host over esp-hosted) is replaced by a host fake that keeps its rules (console ring, app characteristics, battery, scan table, find/hear, pulsed adverts, pairing with a passkey on the Dot, 3 bonds persisted in a region, permission checks); the page's Sensor and Phone bench objects are the other side of the air

supersedes.components/kdrv/radio/src/kdrv_ble.c: web fake: runtime/drivers/ble replaces the NimBLE host (NimBLE is not in this tree) and answers the whole of kdrv_ble.h from bench objects. kdrv_ble_adv.c, kdrv_ble_app.c, kdrv_ble_bonds.c, kdrv_ble_heard.c, kdrv_ble_find.c and AO_Radio stay the SDK's.
